raw_text: Hamas launched the deadliest attack on Israel in decades early Saturday, killing hundreds and taking dozens hostage in a surprise assault from the Gaza Strip. Israel declared a state of war as the military mobilized tens of thousands of reservists. The multi-pronged attack included rockets, ground infiltration, and naval assault, catching Israel's intelligence apparatus off guard.
